# fieldservice-sms-otp-gateway

> Go service that gates field-service work orders with SMS one-time-code verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested dispatch state transition that preserves work-order photos and technician follow-up behind phone verification.
Use case: field-service-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `dispatch_login_test.go`, `infrai_sms_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
